answer: Detect Sybils at the output layer, not the key layer. Embed each answer in vector space and cluster answers whose cosine similarity clears 0.85; a cluster of k near-identical answers shares one slice of the epoch pool, so each earns 1/k of a solo answer. Clones cut from one template forfeit 999/1000 of their payout, so a farm must fund a thousand distinct reasoning runs to keep its slot. Similarity runs on public text, so evasion costs an engineering bill only farmers pay. Honest answers settle into separate layers like shale; a copy farm pools in one lagoon and gets no pearl.
